آخِذٌ , (as in some copies of the K, in both of
the senses here explained,) or ↓ أَخِذْ (as in other copies of the K, and in the L and TA, [but the former is the more agreeable with the form of the pl.,]) A camel beginning to become fat; (L, K;) or to become aged: (K:) pl. أَوَاخِذُ (L.) ＝
-A2- Milk that bites the tongue; syn. قَارِصٌ. (K.) [See أَخُذَ.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
